contracts.source: OpenAI press release: Stargate Advances with 4.5 GW Partnership with Oracle (07-22-2025)
contracts.signal: Oracle and OpenAI entered an agreement to develop 4.5 gigawatts of additional Stargate data center capacity in the U.S.; with Stargate I in Abilene, Texas this brings OpenAI to over 5 gigawatts of Stargate AI data center capacity under development, running over 2 million chips. Oracle began delivering the first Nvidia GB200 racks at Abilene the month before.
